title: zazzled component diagram
description: The zazzled crate and what crosses its boundary: the C invoker (as zazzle, zazz or an installed script's shim) and MCP clients call it; it drives launchd on macOS, asks zazzle-csharp-indexer for C# views and structure, and as the MCP proxy talks to other MCP servers. For zazz scripts it reads archives with zazz-format, speaks the script protocol from zazz-sdk (whose sources it also compiles for scripts with the user's rustc), and starts zazz-worker to compile, test and run them; on macOS the Keychain takes part in trusting a script's signer. The crate's parts are in the src/ diagram.

components.name: zazzled
components.responsibility: The daemon, its MCP front end, the MCP proxy, the command runner, its installer, the zazzle commands and the zazz script commands, in one binary.

components.name: zazzled source
components.responsibility: Library and binary entry: front ends, wire protocol, engine, caches, commands, proxy, runner and zazz scripts.

components.name: zazzle invoker
components.responsibility: The C client a shell runs: passes its command line, streams and working directory to the daemon and exits with its status, or execs `zazzled proxy` and `zazzled wrap`; run as `zazz` it sends zazz commands, and under any other name (an installed script's shim) it runs that script.

components.name: zazzle-csharp-indexer
components.responsibility: The C# tool whose daemon renders the terse view of a C# file and answers the structure tools; it lists no tools of its own.

components.name: zazz-format
components.responsibility: The .zazz file: ZIP reading and deterministic packing, the manifest, the signature envelope and the script id.

components.name: zazz SDK
components.responsibility: The script protocol (frames, messages, descriptor passing), the human CLI parser and output rendering, and the library every Rust script is compiled against, with its zazz::test fakes.

components.name: zazz-worker
components.responsibility: The WebAssembly host: AOT-compiles a module, runs a script's tests, and serves calls to a script in a fresh instance each.

components.name: Rust toolchain
components.responsibility: The user's rustc (with the wasm32-wasip1 target): compiles the SDK, scripts and their tests, to WebAssembly or, for natively trusted scripts, to the host.

components.name: macOS Keychain
components.responsibility: The operating system's certificate trust on macOS: evaluates a signer's chain, and holds the trust settings `zazz trust add` sets for an authority.

components.name: MCP client
components.responsibility: The coding agent's client, which starts `zazzled mcp` and calls its tools over standard input and output, or starts `zazzle proxy` in front of another server.

components.name: Upstream MCP server
components.responsibility: Any other MCP server the proxy sits in front of, run as a child over stdio or reached over Streamable HTTP.

components.name: launchd
components.responsibility: macOS's service manager: holds an installed LaunchAgent's socket and starts `zazzled serve` on demand.

relationships.description: Sends requests over the unix socket in descriptor mode, starts `zazzled serve` when nothing listens, and execs `zazzled proxy` and `zazzled wrap`; as `zazz` or a shim the request is a zazz command.
Starts `zazzled mcp` and speaks JSON-RPC to it, or talks to another server through `zazzled proxy`.
Starts its daemon when needed and asks its `view` and structure tools over the daemon's socket.
The proxy relays the client's messages to it and cleans its answers.
Reads, validates and packs .zazz archives, parses manifests and signature envelopes, and ids scripts by the BLAKE3 of their bytes.
Frames and descriptor passing to workers, the human CLI parser and rendering; embeds the SDK's sources and compiles them into an rlib per toolchain and target.
Runs `zazz-worker compile` and `zazz-worker test` under the OS sandbox, and keeps warm `zazz-worker serve` processes per script, directory and policy.
Runs rustc with an argument list, a cleared environment and a timeout, under the OS sandbox, to build the SDK, scripts and tests.
On macOS, evaluates a signer's chain with SecTrust and sets an authority's trust settings for `zazz trust add`.
Frames, messages, the HTTP wire layout and the host allowlist.
